sum: Springview Holdings Ltd, through its subsidiary, designs and constructs residential and commercial buildings in Singapore. The company undertakes new construction, reconstruction, and additions and alterations works. It also offers general contracting services, such as renovation and design consultation, space planning, and bespoke carpentry, as well as project management services. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Singapore. Springview Holdings Ltd operates as a subsidiary of AVANTA (BVI) LIMITED.
